name: CI

# Validates content and builds the site for pull requests.
# Also dispatchable on any branch: the submission workflow triggers it on the PR branches it opens.
# PRs created with GITHUB_TOKEN either don't trigger pull_request runs or need a maintainer to
# approve them ("action required"), so the dispatched run reports a commit status ("CI / dispatched")
# that shows up on the PR without any manual step.
on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  statuses: write   # only used on workflow_dispatch to report the result on the commit (see last step)

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate & build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Validate content (annotations + job summary on failure)
        run: node scripts/validate.mjs
      - name: Build
        run: node scripts/build.mjs
      - name: Check dist
        run: node scripts/check-dist.mjs
      - name: Report result as a commit status (dispatched runs only)
        if: always() && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          JOB_STATUS: ${{ job.status }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          state=failure; desc="Validation or build failed; see run for annotations"
          if [ "$JOB_STATUS" = "success" ]; then state=success; desc="Content valid, site builds"; fi
          gh api -X POST "repos/$GH_REPO/statuses/$SHA" -f state="$state" -f context="CI / dispatched" -f description="$desc" -f target_url="$RUN_URL" >/dev/null
